activity_c.text: Good morning, Saman.
Before we start, I want to confirm today’s work plan.
We need all the finished cupboards ready for packing by late afternoon.
Good morning, sir. I understand.
Sir, can I adjust the work order slightly and finish the drawer units first?
That section is smaller, and it allows the packing team to start earlier.
Sure, you can. That sounds practical.
Just keep the main schedule in mind.
Thank you, sir.
Also, may I use the inspection table near the office?
It is closer to the packing area, and communication is easier there.
Of course, you may. That table is free today, and it helps reduce delays.
Sir, do you think I can bring one of the helpers from the sanding section for an hour?
The frames need checking, and two people make the work faster and safer.
I’m sorry, it might be a bit of a problem at the moment.
The sanding section is busy right now, but you can request help after lunch.
That’s fine, sir.
One more thing — can I temporarily store the finished units near the loading bay?
That area is closer, and handling is easier for the transport team.
Yes, you may, as long as the pathway stays clear and safety rules are followed.
Thank you, sir. I appreciate that.
Could you ask the supervisor to instruct the new helpers on safety rules?
Sure, I will. Clear instructions make the workshop safer for everyone.
Thanks for reminding me.
